task_definition.task_name: Epicentral Distance Estimation using SeisT on Continuous Waveform

task_description.overview: Estimate the epicentral distance of an earthquake from continuous seismic waveform data using a pretrained SeisT deep learning model.
steps: 1. Load the SeisT model backbone and pretrained weights.
2. Read continuous seismic waveform data from a MiniSEED file using ObsPy.
3. Normalize the multi-channel waveform data by removing the mean and scaling by standard deviation (or maximum amplitude).
4. Convert the normalized waveform data into a torch tensor and move it to the computation device (CPU/GPU).
5. Run a forward pass through the SeisT model to obtain the estimated epicentral distance.
6. Retrieve and return the distance estimation from the model output.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Epicentral distance estimation using `seist_l` deep learning model on the continuous three-component waveform data. Load and normalize the continuous three-component waveform file at {waveform_path} with the specific {normalize_mode} mode, then use the three-component waveform as the model input. The pretrained seist_l model is located at {checkpoint_path} and its related parameters are {model_params}. Run inference by feeding the full-length waveform into the model to obtain a single epicentral distance estimate (no need segment the waveform), and save the estimated value into a json file {result_data.file_name} with content {result_data.file_content}. Finally, plot a figure to show the waveform with the predicted epicentral distance estimation results and save it to {waveform_with_distance}.
